subject: unable to execute .R files via rapache

messages.author: 93734343977fa8c7
messages.subject: unable to execute .R files via rapache
parts:
Hi everybody, I am trying to execute test.R file using rapache. I have this in my httpd.conf file:
    <Location "/R">
      SetHandler r-script
        RHandler sys.source
    </Location>
This is the content of test.R, very simple:
 
<%
x<-1:10000
t=plot(x)
print(t)
%>
when enter, http://<localhost>/R/test.R to the url, I get Internal Server error. Apache log says this:
Traceback:
2: parse(n = -1, file = file)
1: sys.source(file = "/usr/local/apache2/htdocs/R/test.R", envir = .rAenv)
 
any ideas, what I am missing? Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 42eed4e1caba0ad0
messages.subject: Re: unable to execute .R files via rapache
parts:
With current setup, either get rid of <% %> tags, or use brew::brew in RHandler. Try sys.source-ing the file from interactive R session, and you'll see what's the problem... =)

aL3xa
